submitted_sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01'), base AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01') SELECT cur.revenue AS current_year_revenue, base.revenue AS base_year_revenue, CASE WHEN base.revenue IS NULL OR base.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (cur.revenue - base.revenue) / base.revenue END AS yoy_growth_rate FROM cur CROSS JOIN base;
validated_sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)), base AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) SELECT cur.revenue AS current_year_revenue, base.revenue AS base_year_revenue, CASE WHEN base.revenue IS NULL OR base.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (cur.revenue - base.revenue) / base.revenue END AS yoy_growth_rate FROM cur CROSS JOIN base LIMIT 200
